Brick and Brew — Vibrant Dining Restaurant in Hubballi

Nostalgic flavours served with a bold, modern edge at Radiant Vista on Gokul Road, Hubballi.

Restaurant in Hubballi

Premium Nostalgia with a Modern Twist

Ever craved butter chicken that looks like a masterpiece? Or momo with a dimsum twist? Welcome to Brick and Brew—where every dish is a throwback to your favourite food memories, but with a bold, modern edge.

Walk in and you’re hit with retro Bollywood beats, earthy vibes, pomegranate motifs (that’s our OG inspo!), and maybe even a flaming cocktail. Born from a love for comforting food and the cultural quirks we all grew up with, Brick and Brew blends the flavours of the past with the style and spirit of today’s India.

Think your nani’s dal but with five-star plating twist. This is not just another restaurant; it's a feeling like no other. 'It’s India but cooler, sassier, and way more Instagrammable.'
